classes.purpose: Profile, interpret, validate, and visualize the user's business data
classes.content: CSV, XLSX, or Parquet fields and values; dataset identity; metrics, dimensions, periods, identifiers, members, source notes, and compatibility evidence

classes.purpose: Author reusable dataset semantics and choose a source-backed analysis
classes.content: Dataset profiles, intake receipts, semantic layers, evidence, reviewed Sales/Discount/COGS mapping states, role bindings, snapshot attachments, analysis policies, chart plans, exact input and output byte hashes, effective recipe records, rendered charts, authoritative calculation and report validation results, model-authored interpretations, and calculation evidence receipts with stable claim identifiers, dependency edges, verification runs, and shared case-register bindings

boundaries_beyond_codex.purpose: Install Clara's exact declared Python dependencies into a user-scoped managed virtual environment when the fingerprinted dependency cache is absent, invalid, or no longer matches the Python platform
boundaries_beyond_codex.content: Declared package names and version constraints from Clara requirements files, plus ordinary package-index request metadata; no user files, prompts, case data, or report content are sent
controls: Claude Cowork's trusted SessionStart hook and Codex's first dependency check install only requirements declared in the published Clara package.
Dependencies are installed into Clara's user-scoped plugin data directory rather than the plugin source or connected case folder.
The manager validates imports after installation and keys reuse by the requirements fingerprint, Python ABI, and operating-system platform.
The reporting-engine component uses its own persistent managed virtual environment; the optional shared OCR runtime remains separate.
